newsitem.title: MEXICO: Empaques Ponderosa obtains $70 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Empaques Ponderosa obtains $70 mln loan.

text.p: Packaging company Empaques Ponderosa S.A. de C.V. said on Wednesday it had obtained a three-year syndicated loan worth $70 million.
The loan will pay interest each quarter at a rate of LIBOR plus 2.5 basis points for the first year, 2.75 basis points for the second year, and 3.25 basis points for the third year, the company said.
The lead syndicator was ING Barings, with Bank of America, Bank of Montreal, Comercia Bank, First Chicago, Bamanex Investment Bank, and Hua Nan Commercial Bank taking part in the loan.

"The funds will be used to pay down the $50 million Eurobond that will come due next December, and $20 million will be used to support the expansion of installed capacity from 150,000 to 180,000 tonnes of cardboard annually," the company said.
It said it will invest a total of about $45 million to accomplish the production increase.
Empaques said that with this loan, it will have refinanced 80 percent of its debts.
